title: Social media, l'Agcom avvia verifiche con la Commissione Ue sugli algoritmi di Meta. Focus sui contenuti politici
snippet: This regulatory news piece details how Italy's communications regulatory authority (Agcom) launched an investigation in coordination with the European Commission. The decision was driven directly by Fabio Giglietto's study showing how Meta's opaque algorithms asymmetric moderation patterns penalized moderate and institutional politicians in favor of extremist content.
description: An Italian news article reporting on regulatory authority Agcom's investigation into Meta's algorithms, driven directly by Fabio Giglietto's academic research on social media moderation patterns.
